items.title: VI Live: Barça op weg naar grote overwinning bij Elche
items.summary: In de Eredivisie staan er drie duels op de rol, waarvan de wedstrijden van PSV en Feyenoord een apart liveblog hebben. Maar met Go Ahead Eagles tegen ADO Den Haag en duels van onder meer Liverpool, Manchester City, Barcelona, Atlético Madrid, Paris Saint-Germain, AC Milan en Juventus hoeven we ons niet te vervelen. Volg het in de VI Live.

items.title: Signs that Jaissle's Newcastle are not to be written off
items.summary: Newcastle United were predicted to struggle from the off by some pundits, but head coach Matthias Jaissle will take encouragement from aspects of their display even after conceding a late equaliser against Liverpool

items.title: Gouden wissel Rabiot leidt Milan bij debuut Amorim naar zege
items.summary: AC Milan heeft tijdens de eerste speelronde van de Serie A een zwaarbevochten overwinning geboekt op bezoek bij het Torino van Kian Fitz-Jim. Atalanta Bergamo won ook, ondanks een tegendoelpunt van Cas Odenthal.

items.title: Valse start PSG: Ferran redt punt, Godts debuteert
items.summary: Paris Saint-Germain heeft het seizoen in de Ligue 1 geopend met een gelijkspel op bezoek bij Stade Rennes. De titelverdediger leek op weg naar een nederlaag, maar hield dankzij debutant Ferran Torres ternauwernood een punt over aan het bezoek aan Rhoazon Park. Ook Mika Godts maakte zijn eerste minuten.

items.title: Perez draait het om na vuurwerkincident: 'Medelijden met afstekers… Zo'n laag IQ'
items.summary: Analyticus Kenneth Perez heeft geen goed woord over voor de personen die zondag tijdens een duel met SC Cambuur vuurwerk afstaken vanuit het uitvak van Feyenoord .

items.title: Relief for Iraola but Liverpool have work to do
items.summary: Dominik Szoboszlai's injury-time penalty rescues a point at the start of the Andoni Iraola era - but Liverpool need to improv after below-par performance.

items.title: Ernst bijna geraakt door vuurwerk: 'Ik schrok ervan, beangstigend voor iedereen'
items.summary: Tjark Ernst moest zondag rennen om de vuurpijlen uit het uitvak te ontwijken. De doelman van Feyenoord blikte na de uitzege op SC Cambuur terug op de ongeregeldheden in Leeuwarden.

items.title: 'Up front next week?' Maresca's Guehi gamble pays off
items.summary: Rather than playing safe in selecting his Manchester City side for the first time in the Premier League, Enzo Maresca made a bold choice in midfield. Ultimately, it paid off.

items.title: Late penalty for Liverpool denies Newcastle win
items.summary: Szoboszlai rescues a point for Liverpool, scoring a stoppage-time penalty to deny Newcastle an opening game victory at St James' Park in the Premier League.

items.title: European football: Mohamed Salah scores first goals in Trabzonspor victory
items.summary: Atlético’s Julián Alvarez booed by fans in draw Harry Kane named player of year in Germany Mohamed Salah scored his first goals for Trabzonspor with a brace in their 2-1 win over Istanbul Basaksehir. The former Liverpool forward joined the Super Lig side on a two-year deal at the start of August and made his debut for the club from the bench in their 1-1 draw at Kasimpasa last week. items.title: Liverpool’s Szoboszlai spot on with late, late leveller to salvage point at Newcastle
items.summary: Before kick-off a banner was raised in the Gallowgate End inscribed with a quotation from the late Kevin Keegan. “I want people to dream about their football,” it read. “We should all be dreamers at heart.” Out on the pitch it swiftly became apparent that both Matthias Jaissle, Keegan’s latest successor in the Newcastle dugout, and Liverpool’s new manager Andoni Iraola are on individual missions to create forms of organised chaos capable of subjecting the best opponents to torrid nightmares. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘Call his agent’: Emery feels Watkins should explain absence from Villa’s rout by Brighton
items.summary: England forward is considering move to Al-Hilal ‘This question is for him … I answer only with silence’ Unai Emery did nothing to deny that Ollie Watkins had refused to play for Aston Villa in their sobering 4-0 defeat by Brighton at the Amex on Sunday. The head coach had a selection crisis up front with Brian Madjo and Tammy Abraham injured. However, he did not include Watkins in the matchday squad as the England striker considers a move to Al-Hilal in Saudi Arabia. Emery was forced to rely on the attacking midfielder Emiliano Buendía as an emergency striker and his team disappeared without trace on the south coast. They were 4-0 down after 31 minutes and had their new signing João Gomes sent off on his debut in the 40th minute. Gomes kicked up and out at the Brighton striker Georginio Rutter after being dispossessed by him. Continue reading...

items.title: Maresca concedes Manchester City ‘a work in progress’ after hair-raising escape
items.summary: Gvardiol’s stoppage-time strike gives City points ‘I’m looking for solutions. When you win games it helps’ Enzo Maresca said Manchester City remain a “work in progress” after Sunday’s last-gasp win over Bournemouth at the Etihad Stadium. Marc Guéhi’s 85th-minute equaliser and Josko Gvardiol’s 91st-minute winner gave City’s new manager victory in his first game, after Marcus Tavernier’s first-half strike for the visitors. Continue reading...

items.title: Manchester City agree deal worth up to €100m for Lille’s Ayyoub Bouaddi
items.summary: Signing will take City’s window spending to nearly £200m Moroccan stood down from Lille’s game against Angers Manchester City have agreed a deal with Lille worth €95m (£81.4m) plus €5m in potential add-ons for Ayyoub Bouaddi, with the Morocco midfielder’s arrival to take the club’s summer spend to nearly £200m after Elliot Anderson’s £116m signing earlier in the window. The 18-year-old was stood down from Lille’s Ligue 1 match against Angers on Sunday before a medical with City and his transfer becoming official in the next few days. Continue reading...

items.title: 🎥 Incendie, envahissement de terrain et frappe en lucarne : prêté par Anderlecht, il émerge du chaos
